statements.text: A table or native index that cannot be read stops the save. The error names it, and no file is written.
statements.notes: Every read error of a table, the vector tables, the registry, a routed table (other than SQLCODE -30) or a global raises SnapshotReadError naming it; the ZIP is opened for writing only after every read (:1035). Evidence: the upstream unit test (fake cursor refusing each table with SQLCODE -99) passed here in val-unit-3-c02. Not triggered live: the condition needs a login refused SELECT on a Graph_KG table (a second IRIS user/role, container security configuration, not available to this lane); the upstream live test tests/e2e/test_460_r271_snapshot_unreadable_table_e2e.py was SKIPPED in the validation e2e run. rx-live-18 records only the readable-namespace context (archive written).

statements.text: The server helpers for vector values refuse any global but those three.
statements.notes: NodeValueJSON and SetNodeJSON both resolve the node through NodeRef, which throws 'not a vector-index global' unless the global is ^IVF, ^PLAID or ^VecIdx. Live over the Native API: reads of ^KG, ^IVG.Ledger, ^IVGAuditRX18 and writes of ^IVGAuditRX18, ^KG refused, 0 journal records; control: ^IVF answers.

statements.text: A restore is refused in strict ledger mode.
statements.notes: restore_snapshot's first statement is the strict-mode check; LedgerStrictModeError live, also for a path that does not exist (so before the file is read). The journal shows only the stats row bump (^Graph.KG.LedgerStatsD rej_strict_block), which guard.py:77 does by design.
live_cases: restore_snapshot in strict ledger mode -> LedgerStrictModeError
restore_snapshot in strict ledger mode of a missing file -> refused before the file is read

statements.text: A restore is refused while the caller's own transaction holds a write.
statements.notes: START TRANSACTION + INSERT on the engine's connection ($TLEVEL 1): CallerTransactionOpenError, 0 journal records, $TLEVEL still 1 and the caller's row still pending afterwards.
live_cases: restore_snapshot with a caller write open -> CallerTransactionOpenError

statements.text: A snapshot archive with another layout note is refused. Nothing is erased first.
statements.notes: A real archive with metadata layout rewritten to 'flat' / 'pre-223', replacing restore (merge=False): ValueError naming the layout, raised before erase_all (:1152); 0 journal records, rx18 rows unchanged.
live_cases: replacing restore of an archive with layout 'flat' -> ValueError, nothing erased
replacing restore of an archive with layout 'pre-223' -> ValueError, nothing erased

statements.text: A row whose column name is not a plain name is refused and counted.
statements.notes: Crafted archive rows whose keys are SQL text ("node_id) VALUES ('rx18:inj'); --" in nodes, a quoted key in rdf_props): merge restore answered failed_rows 1 for the table, the row not inserted, 0 journal records.
live_cases: merge restore of a nodes row with a non-identifier column -> refused, counted
merge restore of an rdf_props row with a quoted/injected column -> refused, counted

statements.text: Vector text that is not numbers is refused and counted.
statements.notes: Node vector text carrying a quote and SQL, and edge vector text 'not numbers': vector_text raises, failed_rows 1 for kg_NodeEmbeddings / kg_EdgeEmbeddings, nothing inserted, 0 journal records. (The routed-table path, :1472, uses the same vector_text; not probed separately.)
live_cases: merge restore of a node vector whose text is not numbers -> refused, counted
merge restore of an edge vector whose text is not numbers -> refused, counted

statements.text: A native index that is not on the restore allow-list is not written. Its lines count as failed.
statements.notes: Archive with globals/IVGAuditRX18.ndjson (2 lines): failed_rows {'^IVGAuditRX18': 2}, not in restored_globals, ^IVGAuditRX18 undefined after. The journal shows only the version floors restore's finally always sets (^KG("__version"), ^NKG("$meta","version"); snapshot.py:1587-1591, ArnoAccel.cls:299-303).
live_cases: merge restore of an archive holding ^IVGAuditRX18 -> not written, 2 lines failed

statements.text: A native index that cannot be written stops the restore. The error says what is done and what is not.
statements.notes: The RuntimeError exists only for an exception escaping _import_global_from_ndjson; that function catches every per-line failure with logger.debug (:1665-1684) and does not count it. Live: ^IVG.GraphMode lines with subscripts [""] and ["rx18y",""] (each <SUBSCRIPT> when set directly) beside a good line: merge restore returned failed_rows {}, restored_globals ['IVG.GraphMode'], no error; the good line written. Stated refusal not implemented for an unwritable line (existing finding F-C1802, reproduced again).
live_cases: merge restore with ^IVG.GraphMode lines that cannot be written -> RuntimeError

statements.text: Every way to load globals keeps to the restore allow-list.
statements.notes: restore_snapshot keeps to restorable_globals (SNP-X2.13 holds), but Graph.KG.Snapshot.ImportGlobals runs $System.OBJ.Load on every *.gof in a directory with no list. Live: the product's own ExportGlobals wrote ^IVGAuditRX18.gof to a scratch /tmp dir; the global was killed; ImportGlobals answered {"imported":1} and set ^IVGAuditRX18("a") (journal), a global outside the allow-list. Scratch dir removed. Existing finding F-1806 (reproduced again).
live_cases: ImportGlobals of a dir holding ^IVGAuditRX18.gof -> refused (not on the allow-list)
